correctness.rationale: The graph eigenprojector weights give explicit resolvent diagonals; their rational difference identifies the critical part; clearing positive denominators yields a quadratic with exactly one positive root for 0<theta<(N-1)/N. The theta=0 endpoint and theta>=(N-1)/N case follow directly. Comparing the polynomials at consecutive smaller-part sizes proves strict balance ordering. The standalone rational Gaussian-elimination verifier replays 1,176 exact full-matrix cases; infinite quantifiers rely on the proof.
